notes: SMB telehealth/clinic SaaS. Primary product: appointment follow-ups + patient messaging + quick visit summaries. Inbound lead — self-serve signup, used free credits. Key ask: can Redwood host PHI-adjacent data under hosted API? They know full HIPAA compliance = enterprise contract but want to understand support for 'BAA-lite' for low-risk data and retention controls. Quote from product lead: "We need to be sure transcripts we send are not retained beyond 30 days and that logs are auditable for compliance review." Very cost conscious — transcripts are long (~2k tokens per visit). Interested in automatic redaction/deid (client-side vs Redwood options). SE call covered: prefix/KV caching, batching to reduce costs; customer worried about latency for chat (target ~ <500ms median for single-turn agent replies) and throughput of concurrent triage sessions (~30 QPS peak). POC plan = 2-week self-serve: 1) basic chat integration, 2) feed 200 anonymized transcripts for summarization + embeddings search, 3) measure latency/cost. Legal is primary blocker — needs clear BAA path OR guidance for de-identification patterns. Recommended follow-ups: send sandbox keys, POC checklist, security FAQ link, short note on retention controls and log export.
